picks.headline: Capricor's regulatory odyssey for DMD cell therapy hits second FDA rejection
picks.blurb: The FDA has turned down Capricor's Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy deramiocel again, this time despite a newly proposed indication.

picks.headline: Invivyd reports positive results for Covid monoclonal antibody
picks.blurb: The company says its antibody protected people strongly against Covid, though questions remain about its regulatory path and whether a market exists.

picks.headline: Kymera reports mid-stage eczema trial success for would-be Dupixent rival
picks.blurb: Results for the oral drug KT-621 in eczema were viewed as among the year's most closely watched immunology readouts.

picks.headline: If the AI bubble bursts, it could create a serious problem for health care
picks.blurb: An opinion piece argues that a health AI company's stock value and the medical worth of its technology are separate questions.

picks.headline: A string of wins with cancer drugs sets Genmab up for its next chapter
picks.blurb: After three late-stage trial successes in about a month, the Danish biotech is turning toward approval filings and self-commercializing two drugs.

picks.headline: New biotech aims to develop next generation CAR-T for multiple myeloma
picks.blurb: Caronilex is developing a CAR-T cell that hits a second target, aiming to prevent the relapses common in myeloma.

picks.headline: How brain implant trial participants want researchers to do better
picks.blurb: A coalition founder who took part in brain-implant research says device developers should give participants more say in how studies are run.

picks.headline: Kennedy funds $47 million in 'Food is Medicine' pilot projects
picks.blurb: HHS's MAHA ELEVATE pilot lets 15 U.S. groups test whether lifestyle and nutrition-coaching programs merit Medicare coverage.

picks.headline: Aging drives distinct chromatin signatures of CD8 T cell dysfunction and the emergence of a unique CD8 Treg cell population
picks.blurb: Mapping chromatin in young and aged mice, researchers link T cell dysfunction to lost gene regulation and identify a regulatory CD8 population that appears with aging.

picks.headline: C-BRAIN presents OpenScientist, an agentic AI to lend you a hand
picks.blurb: An open agentic AI platform aims to help Alzheimer's researchers turn large datasets into discoveries, with traceable reasoning and code, as described in Nature Medicine.
